_comment: Per-client config — copy to client.json (gitignored), one per company. Capability-based: declare the PROVIDER per capability. STANDARD CLIENT PROFILE baked in below: Notion tracker (always) · email (always) · HubSpot CRM (always — the single source of truth) · shared Slack (some clients). One company = one config = one Claude workspace = one tracker.

email._note: Always on — every client communicates via email.

crm._note: Always on — the pipeline lives in HubSpot, the single source of truth (canonical deal/contact/company list, and where comms notes + stages are written). See HUBSPOT_SETUP.md.

chat._note: Only SOME clients — set enabled:false if there's no shared Slack. Prefer a shared Slack Connect channel in your own workspace over per-client tokens (see CONNECTIONS.md).

meetings._note: Optional — enable if the client uses a meeting-notes tool you can read.

execution._note: Triage always runs. 'enabled' lets AI prepare the AI-doable slices (drafts, staged updates). 'autoSend' OFF by default.
